'''Christophe Dessimoz''' is a [[Swiss National Science Foundation]] (SNSF) Professor at the [[University of Lausanne]], Associate Professor at [[University College London]] and a group leader at the [[Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics]].<ref name=lab>{{cite web|url=https://lab.dessimoz.org/people/christophe-dessimoz|title=Dessimoz Lab|first=Christophe |last=Dessimoz|year=2019|website=lab.dessimoz.org}}</ref><ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name=epmc>{{EuropePMC|ORCID=0000-0002-2170-853X}}</ref><ref name=scopus>{{Scopus id}}</ref><ref name=twitter>{{twitter}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Overton Prize]] in 2019 for his contributions to [[computational biology]].<ref name=overton>{{cite journal|last1=Kovats|first1=Diane|last2=Shamir|first2=Ron|last3=Fogg|first3=Christiana|title=2019 ISCB Overton Prize: Christophe Dessimoz|journal=F1000Research|volume=8|year=2019|page=722|issn=2046-1402|doi=10.12688/f1000research.19220.1|pmid=31164977 |pmc=6534074 |doi-access=free }}</ref> Starting in April 2022, he will be joint executive director of the SIB [[Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics]], along with [[Ron Appel]].

==Education==
Dessimoz obtained his [[Master of Science]] degree in 2003<ref name=lab/> and [[PhD]] in [[Computer Science]] in 2009 from [[ETH Zurich]] in [[Switzerland]]<ref name=dphd>{{cite thesis|degree=PhD|first=Christophe|last=Dessimoz|url=https://www.research-collection.ethz.ch/handle/20.500.11850/72801|year=2009|title=Comparative Genomics Using Pairwise Evolutionary Distances|doi=10.3929/ethz-a-005762050|website=ethz.ch|oclc=935351416|publisher=ETH Zurich|hdl=20.500.11850/72801 }} {{open access}}</ref> where his doctoral research was supervised by [[Gaston Gonnet]]<ref name=mathgene/> and examined by [[Amos Bairoch]].<ref name=dphd/>

==Career and research==
After [[postdoctoral research]] at the [[European Bioinformatics Institute]] (EBI) on the [[Wellcome Genome Campus]] in [[Hinxton]], [[Cambridgeshire]],<ref name="GoldmanBertone2013">{{cite journal|last1=Goldman|first1=Nick|last2=Bertone|first2=Paul|last3=Chen|first3=Siyuan|last4=Dessimoz|first4=Christophe|last5=LeProust|first5=Emily DNA|journal=Nature|volume=494|issue=7435|year=2013|pages=77–80|issn=0028-0836|doi=10.1038/nature11875|pmid=23354052|pmc=3672958 |bibcode=2013Natur.494...77G}}</ref> he joined [[University College London]] (UCL) as [[lecturer]]  in 2013, and was promoted to [[Reader (academic rank)|Reader]] in 2015.<ref name=lab/> In 2015, he joined the [[University of Lausanne]] as  professor, retaining an appointment at UCL.<ref name=ucl>{{cite web|url=https://www.ucl.ac.uk/biosciences/departments/gee/staff/tabs/academic-iris-link/dessimoz|title=Dr Christophe Dessimoz|website=ucl.ac.uk|access-date=6 Dessimoz is known for his management of the [[Orthologous MAtrix]] (OMA)<ref name=oma>{{cite journal|last1=Altenhoff|first1=Adrian M|last2=Glover|first2=Natasha M|last3=Train|first3=Clément-Marie|last4=Kaleb|first4=Klara|last5=Warwick Vesztrocy|first5=Alex|last6=Dylus|first6=David|last7=de Farias|first7=Tarcisio M|last8=Zile|first8=Karina|last9=Stevenson|first9=Charles|last10=Long|first10=Jiao|last11=Redestig|first11=Henning|last12=Gonnet|first12=Gaston H|last13=Dessimoz|first13=Christophe|title=The OMA orthology database in 2018: retrieving evolutionary relationships among all domains of life through richer web and programmatic interfaces|journal=Nucleic Acids Research|volume=46|issue=D1|year=2018|pages=D477–D485|issn=0305-1048|doi=10.1093/nar/gkx1019|pmid= 29106550 |pmc=5753216 }}</ref> which provides information on [[sequence homology|orthologous]] [[protein]]s. OMA has important applications in [[protein function prediction]].<ref name=overton/> Dessimoz's approach to [[Benchmark (computing)|benchmarking]] had a major impact on three key subfields of computational biology: [[sequence homology|orthology inference]], [[sequence alignment]], and the [[gene ontology]] (GO).<ref name=overton/><ref name=GO>{{cite book|editor-last1=Dessimoz|editor-first1=Christophe|editor-last2=Škunca|editor-first2=Nives|volume=1446|year=2017|issn=1064-3745|doi=10.1007/978-1-4939-3743-1|title=The Gene Ontology Handbook|isbn=978-1-4939-3743-1|series=Methods in Molecular Biology|last1=Dessimoz|first1=Christophe|s2cid=3708801}} {{open access}}</ref><ref name="GaudetŠkunca2017">{{cite book|last1=Gaudet|first1=Pascale|title=The Gene Ontology Handbook|last2=Škunca|first2=Nives|last3=Hu|first3=James C.|last4=Dessimoz|first4=Christophe|chapter=Primer on the Gene Ontology|volume=1446|year=2017|pages=25–37|issn=1064-3745|doi=10.1007/978-1-4939-3743-1_3|pmid=27812933|pmc=6377150|series=Methods in Molecular Biology|isbn=978-1-4939-3741-7}}</ref>

===Awards and honours===
Dessimoz was awarded the [[Overton Prize]] by the [[International Society for Computational Biology]] (ISCB) in 2019 for outstanding contributions to computational biology.<ref name=overton/>
